observation.command:
echo "=== CPU flags (avx) ==="; grep -oE "avx[0-9a-z]*|sse4_2|aes" /proc/cpuinfo | sort -u
echo "=== minio magic bytes ==="; head -c 20 /tmp/minio_server | od -An -tx1
echo "=== try minio with minimal env / server mode ==="; cd /tmp && timeout 8 env MINIO_ROOT_USER=a MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=bbbbbbbb ./minio_server /tmp/miniodata --address :9000 2>&1 | head -5; echo "exit=$?"
